findings.description: The loop now only removes names in param.opts and no longer removes names in param.secondary_opts, so a help option name that equals a parameter's secondary option is no longer excluded.
findings.rationale: Trigger: the context sets help_option_names to include a name such as "--no-help", and a command has a boolean flag declared as "--verbose/--no-help", whose secondary opt is "--no-help". Before this change, "--no-help" was removed from the help names because it was in secondary_opts. After the change it stays, so the help option also claims "--no-help" and conflicts with the flag's secondary name. Impact: the help option may shadow or collide with the user's flag, so passing --no-help can trigger help or the flag fails to parse as intended.
